# If it does not contain colon and does not start with "+", then it's a retirement reason (trouble)
# We need to see if ALL such rows have no time listed (i.e., no colon and no leading '+')
# The claim says "any driver below 75 laps care trouble of some kind thus no time listed" – interpreting as: all drivers below 75 laps have trouble (no time listed).
# So we check if every row in below_75 has a 'time / retired' that is NOT a time.

# Define a function to check if a value is a time (contains colon or starts with '+')
def is_time(val):
    if isinstance(val, str):
        return (':' in val) or val.strip().startswith('+')
    else:
        return False

# Apply to each row in below_75
all_no_time = below_75['time / retired'].apply(lambda x: not is_time(x)).all()

# The claim also says "12 drivers below 75 laps." – we need to verify that count as well.
